plan.title: process(review-cycle): SLizard babysit re-polls instead of resolving carried fingerprints

narratives.Description: On SLizard merge-blocking findings, babysit must read the tip review body and resolve Previously mentioned fingerprints before re-arming wait-mergeable. #3167 weather carve-out must not over-license ignoring parseable blocking findings when Greptile is clean.
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Bound lean 5872632888 / synthesis 5872759241: merge-ready tip-body MUST, #3167 vs #4387 rewrite, compose existing falsify HOW, residual fixture.
narratives.Labels: bug, agent-experience, review-cycle, process, source-of-truth, area:cli, design-critique:ingest-ready, framework-gap, core-capabilities
narratives.UserStory: As a review-cycle babysitter, I want merge-ready SLizard blocks to force tip-body fingerprint work before re-arming wait, so that Previously mentioned P1s cannot idle-poll forever under a Greptile-clean #3167 ignore license.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md for merge-ready/wait-mergeable SLizard tip-body MUST and #3167 weather vs residual split; recut matching anti-pattern catalog bullet.
2. Add one-liner cross-link in packages/core/src/slizard/slizard-gate.ts and/or scm docs if needed.
3. Compose existing head-blob falsify HOW; add regression/fixture that carried-open fingerprint is unfinished residual.
4. Mirror consumer-relevant always-pin text via content/templates/agents-entry.md + task agents:refresh; CHANGELOG.md Unreleased.
